digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow and plan review modules
propositions: Nine modules are within 20 lines of or at the 800-LOC cap, creating a structural blocker for necessary feature work such as threading provider_provenance through finalize_verdict in story 343b.
gate_dispatch.py at 799 LOC with only 1 line of headroom cannot accommodate the minimal three-argument addition required by 343b gap-5 without exceeding E501 line-length limits.

The plan-review recovery cluster (STEP_* constants, GateContractError, recovery functions, metrics attachment) within gate_dispatch.py is a cohesive, already-documented seam that can be extracted into a new module with zero test edits.

The context-assembly cluster (assemble_cache, assemble_context, related helpers) within orchestrator.py is a self-contained, purpose-bound seam that can be relocated to free 154 lines of headroom in the origin module.
Extracting both seams using the 2682/3a98 precedent of re-importing moved names into origin modules preserves all monkeypatch boundaries and test harness integration without modification.
